record.question: Which of the following statements about Special Police Officers (SPO) is not correct according to the Mizoram Police Act, 2011?
options: The SPO shall have the same powers, privileges and immunities and be liable to the same duties and responsibilities and be subject to the same authorities as an ordinary police officer.
Every SPO so appointed shall be honorary in nature.
On appointment, the SPO does not need to undergo training.
Any able-bodied and willing person between the age of 18 and 50 years, whom the competent authority considers can be appointed as SPO.
